comments.author: davesoft
comments.body: The tanks looks quite familiar, though I guess there's only so many ways to do a low poly tank. My game has a parody of Advanced Wars in it, so I have a 5 tank squad that moves like it's one unit, and it's attack power is set by how much health it has left. An idea you could use maybe? Not the multi unit bit, but, 'this tank has 3 phases of damage' kinda thing.
